rule: Hunted nightmoths flee to dimmer lights
texts: When a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the nightmoths that survive the hunt flee toward dim lanterns.
Whenever a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the nightmoths that survive the hunt move to the Hollows.
When a nightmoth flees and reaches the Hollows, the lanterns at the Hollows gain silken threads.

fields.sentence: When a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the nightmoths that survive the hunt flee toward dim lanterns.
parse: (: hunt_flee_rule (Implication (And (Member $c sky_cat) (Member $h hunt) (Agent $h $c) (Location $h $lr) (Member $lr lantern_row) (Member $n nightmoth) (Member $sv survive) (Agent $sv $n) (Theme $sv $h)) (And (Member (sk_flee $n $h) flee) (Agent (sk_flee $n $h) $n) (GroupOf (sk_dim_lanterns $h) lantern) (Member (sk_dim_lanterns $h) dim) (Goal (sk_flee $n $h) (sk_dim_lanterns $h)) (During (sk_flee $n $h) $h))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: (Member (sk_dim_lanterns $h) dim) predicates the descriptive modifier 'dim' of the group symbol itself, which Categorical statements explicitly bars — a descriptive modifier or copular predicate on a plural always goes through the distributive rule, never a bare (Member <group> <prop>).

q2_gaps: a definite plural restricted by a relative clause ('the nightmoths that survive the hunt') as the consequent subject of a whenever rule — the instruction set prescribes a group witness for definite plurals and per-member variables for explicit universals, but does not say which applies here
'toward' as a directional oblique — Goal is defined for 'to / into / onto' plus the whither test, while the surface-preposition rule elsewhere forbids synonym heads, so 'toward' is left unresolved
review.notes: The hunt event variable is correctly reused as the antecedent of the definite 'the hunt', and the flee Skolem (sk_flee $n $h) is properly indexed by the trigger occurrence.

issues.reason: Categorical statements bars predicating a members' property of the group symbol (a bare (Member <group> <prop>) is reserved for properties of the collection itself), and 'dim' is incidental description that never fuses, so (Member (sk_dim_lanterns $h) dim) asserts the collection-as-object is dim — the exact reading the plural rules warn against — instead of distributing over the members.

gaps_confirmed: a definite plural restricted by a relative clause ('the nightmoths that survive the hunt') as the consequent subject of a whenever rule: neither the definite-plural group-witness prescription nor the per-member-variable route is designated for this position
'toward' as a directional oblique: the whither test points at Goal but Goal's own listing is 'to / into / onto', while the never-a-synonym-head rule points at a surface (Toward ...) — unresolved
new_gaps: no licensed form for distributing a descriptive modifier over a Skolem group minted inside a rule conclusion: the mandated per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (Member $x <prop>)) must reference the occurrence-bound group and so must nest inside the conclusion, a nesting the instruction set licenses only inside sealed terms
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form keeps (GroupOf (sk_dim_lanterns $h) lantern) and hands 'dim' to the members via a per-member distribution rule (Implication (PartOf $x (sk_dim_lanterns $h)) (Member $x dim)) rather than (Member <group> dim) — though whether that distribution rule may nest inside a rule conclusion is itself unlegislated, filed as a gap.
adjudication.notes: Everything else in the rule — the donkey-style premise reusing $h for 'the hunt', survive with Agent/Theme, the (sk_flee $n $h) Skolem over both universals, During, and the 1.0/0.9 TV — is compliant.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the nightmoths that survive the hunt move to the Hollows.
parse: (: whenever_hunt_survive_move (Implication (And (Member $c sky_cat) (Member $e hunt) (Agent $e $c) (Member $r lantern_row) (Location $e $r) (Member $m nightmoth) (Member $s survive) (Agent $s $m) (Theme $s $e)) (And (Member (sk_move $s) move) (Agent (sk_move $s) $m) (Goal (sk_move $s) hollows) (During (sk_move $s) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a definite plural restricted by a relative clause acting as the subject of a whenever-rule consequent ("the nightmoths that survive the hunt move") — the instruction set's definite-plural treatment (group witness plus per-member distribution rule, both emitted) has no stated form inside a rule, so the group half is unreachable and only the per-member range is expressible

the role of a non-perception verb's eventive-noun object ("survive the hunt") — Theme is specified as entity-objects-only and the Stimulus carve-out is restricted to perception verbs, leaving no head explicitly assigned
review.notes: "the Hollows" is handled exactly per the capitalized-plural-label boundary (Name-only individual, no GroupOf, no invented type atom), and the restrictive relative clause is correctly placed in the premises donkey-style. Agent for the self-powered animate movers, Location for "at a lantern-row", and Goal for "to the Hollows" all match the stated tests.

fields.sentence: When a nightmoth flees and reaches the Hollows, the lanterns at the Hollows gain silken threads.
parse: (: whenever_flee_reach_gain (Implication (And (Member $n nightmoth) (Member $e1 flee) (Agent $e1 $n) (Member $e2 reach) (Agent $e2 $n) (Theme $e2 hollows)) (And (Member (sk_gain $e2) gain) (Agent (sk_gain $e2) sk_lanterns_1) (Theme (sk_gain $e2) (sk_threads $e2)) (GroupOf (sk_threads $e2) silken_thread) (During (sk_gain $e2) $e2))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: Missing the mandatory solid-compound genus atom (Inheritance nightmoth moth) for the transparently modifier+head symbol 'nightmoth' — the same decomposition is correctly emitted for 'silken_thread' in this very parse.

q2_gaps: a definite plural with a distributive predicate ('the lanterns gain silken threads') sitting inside a whenever-rule CONSEQUENT: doctrine adds a per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) rule beside the group event, but no form for nesting that rule inside a rule consequent is given (the nesting licence is stated only for sealed complements)
review.notes: 'the Hollows' correctly takes the capitalized-plural Name-only treatment (Name atom, no GroupOf, no invented type atom), 'at the Hollows' correctly uses the static LocatedIn, and 'reaches' takes Theme exactly as the prompt's own reach example does.

issues.reason: Compound concepts mandates the genus for a transparently modifier+head solid compound ('the solid spelling is never a reason to skip decomposition', and Core patterns lists the genus as always emitted), so (Inheritance nightmoth moth) is required and absent — as the parse's own silken_thread decomposition shows it knew.

gaps_confirmed: a definite plural with a distributive predicate ('the lanterns ... gain silken threads') inside a whenever-rule consequent: doctrine adds a per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) beside the group event, but no form for placing that rule inside a rule consequent is given (the nesting licence exists only for sealed terms)
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form adds the missing decomposition atom (: nm_genus (Inheritance nightmoth moth) (STV 1.0 0.99)) beside the rule; the noun modifier 'night' stays unexposed per the modifier test.
adjudication.notes: The rest is compliant: 'the Hollows' takes the capitalized-plural Name-only treatment, 'at the Hollows' the static LocatedIn on the lantern group, reach takes Theme, and the gain response is properly Skolem-keyed on the trigger occurrence $e2 with During and the 1.0/0.9 TV.
